expected_work: Import and inspect concentration-time data; derive and implement the transformations for three reaction orders.
provided_support: Named functions, ordered steps, one completed transformation, and code blanks; a paper table precedes coding.
interpretation_basis: Students complete expressions for a prescribed set of transformations. The guide supplies the analysis sequence; choosing the reaction order belongs to the separate modelling record.
source_sections: Setting up; Looking at the data; Working out the linearizations; Creating the transformed columns
review_question: Are these expressions completed by students before solutions or demonstrations are provided?

expected_work: Fit three reaction-order candidates, compare fitted plots and R-squared, select an order, and derive its rate constant; later sections apply rate laws and Arrhenius extrapolation.
provided_support: Candidate transformations, one complete fit, plotting examples, equations, and code blanks.
interpretation_basis: Model choice is explicit and students are told to inspect plotted patterns as well as R-squared. The alternatives and workflow are supplied; no unprompted choice of analysis strategy is established.
source_sections: Determining the reaction order; Using the rate constant; Temperature dependence and Arrhenius extrapolation
review_question: Must students explain their choice and its limitations in a required output, and what support is available?

expected_work: Arrange and import pressure-temperature data, apply an instrument-zero correction if relevant, and construct Kelvin, reciprocal-temperature, and log-pressure columns.
provided_support: Spreadsheet layout example, conditional correction instructions, equations, and incomplete code.
interpretation_basis: The guide distinguishes raw from already corrected pressure and explicitly links the new linearisation to the earlier Arrhenius procedure. Whether students encounter the raw-data branch requires confirmation.
source_sections: Importing your data; Correcting raw instrument readings; Setting up the linearisation
review_question: Do students use their own raw readings or a prepared dataset, and who decides whether the zero correction applies?

expected_work: Fit the specified relation by substance and convert coefficients into thermodynamic quantities and boiling points.
provided_support: An explicit analogy to earlier kinetics, a prescribed model, fitting templates, coefficient examples, and the physical relationships.
interpretation_basis: The guide explicitly asks students to reuse the linearisation approach in a different physical context. It specifies the model and parameter relationships; the sampled instructions do not require choosing among competing models.
source_sections: What this guide is for; Clausius-Clapeyron relationship; Fitting a line per substance; From slope and intercept; Standard and normal boiling points
review_question: Is the earlier kinetics task completed first, and must students justify model suitability beyond reporting the line and R-squared?

expected_work: Import dissolution observations, convert absorbance with dilution correction, order and group observations, correct cumulative release for prior sample removal, and summarise replicates.
provided_support: A complete worked implementation, explicit columns and constants, correction equation, and explanatory comments.
interpretation_basis: The central calculation is fully coded. Import guidance asks students to identify CSV formatting and select the matching importer; this bounded choice does not establish independent construction of the correction.
source_sections: Initial setup; Convert absorbance to concentration; Calculate cumulative release; Calculate mean and SD per time point
review_question: Is the complete code available from the outset, and must students explain or adapt the sampling correction?

expected_work: Follow a supplied nonlinear fit, inspect parameter estimates, and plot the fitted curve against dissolution observations.
provided_support: Specified Weibull model, complete code, starting values, parameter explanations, and a complete plotting example.
interpretation_basis: The guide discusses assessing the fitted curve visually and relating starting values to the data, but supplies an implementation. The whole section is explicitly optional.
review_question: Is any written evaluation expected, and is there a separate required modelling task elsewhere in FA503?

expected_work: Import capsule measurements, enter experimental constants, and complete back-calculations from absorbance through dilution to ibuprofen content per mass of powder.
provided_support: Specified data structure, dilution scheme, intermediate variables, formula hints, and complete later per-capsule calculations.
interpretation_basis: Students write calculation expressions within a prescribed sequence and select an importer from file formatting. Applying later acceptance rules is outside this data-preparation record and is not model fitting.
source_sections: Import data; Define key constants; Assay; Ibuprofen Content per Capsule
review_question: Which calculations are completed without demonstrations, and is a justification of the dilution calculation required?

expected_work: Import transport data, write the cumulative sampling correction and interval-flux calculation, and evaluate the transported fraction against sink conditions.
provided_support: Explicit reference to FA503 dissolution, equations, named functions, code blanks, and empty implementation blocks.
interpretation_basis: The guide names the earlier dissolution activity and leaves the cumulative correction and flux code to students. Checking sink conditions is an explicit scientific judgement within a supplied procedure.
source_sections: Relevans og perspektiver; Opsaetning; Databehandling; Kontrol af sink-conditions
review_question: Do students construct the correction using earlier learning, or receive a completed script before doing it?

expected_work: Inspect the transport plot, choose the steady-state interval, fit a line, and derive flux, lag time, and apparent permeability.
provided_support: A prescribed linear model, filter and fitting templates, coefficient guidance, and physical formulas.
interpretation_basis: Selecting the fitting interval is explicit. The guide refers to previous dissolution work, but that alone does not establish an earlier task teaching this specific interval-selection capability.
source_sections: Plot Kumulativ transport mod tid; Steady-state-analyse; Beregning af Papp
review_question: Must students justify their interval and check the resulting interpretation? Where was interval selection previously taught?

expected_work: Combine measurements from four temperatures, check that all are represented, calculate concentrations and theoretical absorbance, and transform absorbance for fitting.
provided_support: A suggested spreadsheet structure, prescribed constants and equations, function hints, and code blanks; groups exchange measurements.
interpretation_basis: The guide asks for a coverage check and student-written expressions within a supplied sequence. Similarity to earlier dilution work is not an explicit cross-course transfer prompt.
source_sections: Baggrund; Opsaetning; Databehandling through Lineariser data
review_question: How are combined group data checked, and which earlier data-preparation routines are explicitly assumed?

expected_work: Fit the specified first-order model by temperature, inspect linearity and slope trends, fit an Arrhenius relation, and calculate activation energy and shelf life at new temperatures.
provided_support: The reaction order and linearisation are supplied; grouped fitting scaffold, extraction hints, equations, and plotting templates are provided.
interpretation_basis: Linearity and temperature trends must be checked, but students do not choose the reaction order. The relationship to FA515 kinetics is plausible from shared methods; this guide does not name that course or task.
source_sections: Lineær regression; Plot Reaktionskinetik; Arrhenius sections; Ekstrapolation; Shelf life
review_question: Is FA515 kinetics explicitly recalled, and what additional explanation or validity judgement is required in the report?
